original_source.title: Randomstrasse101: Open Problems of 2025
original_source.formulation: A universal lower bound on Euclidean Cheeger constant divided by the best half-space cut ratio; equivalently h(mu)>=c/sqrt(||Cov(mu)||_op), uniformly over dimensions and log-concave probabilities.
original_source.source_typo_handling: The arXiv HTML half-space formula binds H but prints S in the ratio. The primary blog uses H consistently. The covariance-normalized formulation is unambiguous in both. The audit uses that formulation and notes the correction explicitly.
